text.body:
||śrī gaṇeśāya namaḥ|| namaskṛtya gaṇādhyakṣaṃ nṛsiṃhaṃ kamalāyutam| buddhiprabhāvardhayitrīṃ saṃhartrīṃ duritasya ca|| saṃpādayitrīṃ kāmānāṃ prapaytrīṃ śriyaḥ śriyam| tātaṃ śambhuṃ satīṃ durgāṃ pāṇiniprabhṛtīn munīn|| bālambhaṭāṭabhidhaṃ -01-0pāyaguṇ‍ḍākhyaṃ paramaṃ gurum| (1. pāyaguṇḍopākhyaṃ paraṃ) gopāladevanāmāsau paṇḍito bālabuddhaye|| kṛṣṇadevānujo loke manudvaparābhidhaḥ| anusṛtya nayaṃ prācāṃ navyānāṃ leśatastathā| laghuno bhūṣaṇasyemāṃ kāntima vitanute sudhīḥ|| prāripsitapratibandhakaduritopaśamanāya śiṣyaśikṣāyai vyākhyātṛśrotṝṇāmanuṣaṅgato maṅgalāya ca samucitadevatānatyātmakaṃ maṅgalamupanibadhnāti - " śrī lakṣmīti" - "rūpamiti"|| tācchīlyaṇiniḥ; natvinirmatvarthīyaḥ| "tadasyāstīti" (sū. 5-2-94) siddhe matupi "rasādibhyaśca" (sū. 5-2-95) ti pinaḥ matubvidhānāt jñāpakāt rasādibhya -01-0anyatamatvarthīyanivṛtteḥ| (1L. anya nāsti|) -02-0ata eva bahuvrīhiṇaivasiddhe vṛttidvayakalpanavaiyathryaśaṅkā| (2L. 'ata eva' ityārabhya .......... 'iti bhāva' ityantaṃ nāvalokyate| tanmate laukike prayoge kvaccillāghavānādareṇa "asubvata" iti bhāṣyaprayogeṇa ca vṛttidvaya kalpanepi kṣatyabhāva iti bhāvaḥ| vastuta "ebhya iniṭhanāvapiṣyete" iti "rasādibhyaśce" (sū. 5-2-95) ti sūtre bhāṣye spaṣṭham| anena ca viṣṇuśivayoḥ abhedaḥ sūcitaḥ|| -2sphoṭarūpamiti-2|| tatvañca anya6 spaṣṭam| vivecayiṣyate cāgre sphoṭavāde| -2vivartata iti-2|| etena jagato brahmavivartākāratoktā| vivarta śabdārthe hi atārthiko'nyathābhāvaḥ| vastutaḥ sopyanya eveti sphoṭe nirūpayiṣyāmaḥ| -2śeṣeti-2|| śeṣasya -03-0ye'śeṣārthastallābhārthastamityarthaḥ| -2dvaiteti-2|| (Vi 'tam' - na dṛśyate|) dvaitaṃ dvaitavādastadeva ghvāntatamastannivāraṇādi phalamasyā ityarthaḥ ādi śabdena mokṣa sukham| dvaitasya ghvāntatvaṃ cāvidayakatvāt|| -2pumbhāveti-2|| pumaso bhāvo yasyāstādṛśīṃ vāgdevatāmityarthaḥ| etena -04-0puruṣarūpatvamapi (4L. rūpamapi ka. 'dṛśyante hayanye rasādibhyo matvarthīyāḥ' ma|bhā. pṛ. 590 dvi.kha.|) sarasvatyā uktaṃ bhavati|| -2upapattibhiḥ-2|| yuktibhiḥ|| -0(bhū.sā.dhā.ni. 1)-0 -0 -0phaṇīti|| tatsphuraṇantu prakṛtaśāstranirmātṛtvena sarvottara munitvena ca abhyarhitatvāt || -2asmābhiriti-2|| bhaṭṭojidīkṣitairityarthaḥ| etena bhaṭṭojidī7itakartṛtvaṃ mūlasya darśitam| ata evāha - -2śabdakaustubha uddhṛta iti-2|| -2phalamiti-2|| -01-0phalatvañca (1. V1 phalañca) kartṛpratyayasamabhivyāhṛtadhātvarthaniṣṭaviśeṣyatānirūpitaprakāratāvatve sati taddhātvarthajanyatvaṃ bodhyam| janyatā ca āropitānāropitā viṣayatvādi sādhāraṇāni -02-0bodhyā| (2. l. bodhyā ......... vāraṇā - nāvalokyate|) vibhāgajanyasaṃyogādirūpe patatyādyarthe vibhāgasaṃyogayoḥ phalatvavāraṇāya viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyayorupādānam| karmapratyayasamabhivyāhāre'pi satvāt dhātośca tadavacchinnāvācakatvādāha - -2vyāpārastvīti-2|| atra phale vyāpāre ca dhātoḥ pa-thak śaktiḥ| na ca ekapadopasthāpyatvātparasparamanvayo na syāditi vācyam| vyutpattivaicitryāttiṅupasthāpyayoḥ kartraikatvayorivānvayābhyupagamāt| anyathā kartṛpratyayasamabhivyāhāre phalāvacchinnavyāpāre dhātuśakteriva -01-0karmapratyayasamabhivyāhāre vyāpārāvacchinnaphale tacchakterāvaśyakatvena guruśakyatāvacchedakaśaktidvayakalpanāpattiḥ| (1L. vyāhāre - nāsti) vastutaḥ prāmāṇikagauravasyādoṣatvācchaktidvayakalpanaiva jyāyasī, anyathā pṛthagupasthitayoruddeśyavidheyabhāvenānvayasyautsargikatvātphalavyāpārayorapi tiṅarthakartraikatvayoriva tathānvayāpatteḥ| tattadviśeṣaṇakabodhe kartṛpratyayādisamabhivyādṛtadhātujanyopasthiteśca kāraṇatādvayakalpanāpattiśceti|| -0ka -0"yāvatsiddhamiti"|| (ka. vā.pa. III. kriyā. saṃ. kā. 1) yāvat - sarvam| siddham - apākṣīdityādau| asiddham pacati, pakṣyatītyādau| sādhyatvenābhidhīyamānaṃ kriyā| 'ghaṭaḥ kriyate' ityādau kriyādvāraiva ghaṭasyasādhyatvapratītiḥ| ghaṭa ityetāvanmātratsādhyatvāpratīteḥ|| "-2āśriteti-2"|| kriyate avayavānāṃ krameṇotpadyate yā seti yogapradarśanaparam| samudāyasya ca sākṣāt kriyāviṣayatvābhāvepyavayavadvārakaṃ kriyāviṣayatvaṃ, kriyāśabdasya "kṛñaḥ śa ca" (sū. 3-3-100) karmaṇiśapratyayāntatvāt| tathā ca kramikāvayavotpattidvārotpādyatvena vivakṣitatvaṃ -01-0kriyātvaṃ (1L. 'kriyātvaṃ' ityāditaḥ 'pāka ityādau' ityantaṃ na dṛśyate|) paryavasannamiti bhāvaḥ|| -2pacati-2 -2pāka-2 -2iti-2 || 'pacatī'tyādau kriyāntarākāṅkṣāyā adarśanamiti 'pāka ityādau' kriyāntarākāṅā7yādarśanamiti vyutkarameṇānvayaḥ|| -02-0-2tathā-2 -2ceti-2 || ( 2V1. tathā ca| ) -03-0kriyāntarākāṅkṣayā ( 3. Vi. kriyāntarākāṅkṣayā) anutthāpikā pacatīśabdopāttā kriyā tadavacchedakarūpaṃ pacatyādiśabdastadbodhyatvarūpaṃ tadvatvañca tatkariyāyāmasti| athavā kriyāntarākāṅkṣānuthāpakatāvacchedakarūpaṃ tat kriyāgata vaijātyaṃ yat tadvatvañca tatkarayāyāmiti lakṣaṇasaṅgatiḥ| na caivaṃ dhātuto nirūpakatvaijātyena kriyopasthitau 'kṛṣṇaṃ nameccet sukhaṃ yāyādi'tyādau nirākāṅākṣatayā'nanvayaprasaṅga iti vācyam| cecchabdhasamabhivyāhāravaśādākāṅkṣotthānāt| evaṃ yacchabdādāvapi ūhyam| 'bhuktve'ti dhātusambandhe vidhīyamānaktvādisamabhivyāhāravat| -04-0kriyāntarākāṅkṣatvañca (4. Vi. kriyāntarākāṅkṣatvañca) kriyātvena kriyopasthitiṃ vinā śābdabodhānanubhāvakatvam| tena 'paśya mṛgo dhāvati', 'pacati bhavati' ityādau dhāvanakriyābhavanakriyayoḥ sādhyatvāsatvabhūtatvayoḥ na hāniḥ| kecittu kriyātvena kriyāniveśamapahāyastitvantarākāṅkṣānutthāpakatāvachedakavaijātyameva tatpariṣkaraṇīyam| 'āsa' ityādau sādhyatvāsatvabhūtatvayoḥ vāraṇāyāntareti vijātīyārthakaṃ vijātīyāstitvākāṅkṣetyarthaḥ| pacati, bhavati, astītyādau cāvyāptivāraṇārthaṃ pūrvavadevākāṅkṣā narvaktavyā| -02-0'paśya mṛge' (L. 'paśya' ārabhya 'ityuktau' paryantaṃ na dṛśyate|) tu yathā śrute'pi na doṣaḥ| liṅgasaṃkhyākārakānvayitvamasatvabhūtatvamityuktau tu niruktakriyayoḥ krameṇa karmatvakartṛtvānvayadarśanāt, 'hata śāyiktraḥ śayyate' ityādau saṅkhyānvayadarśanāccāsatvabhūtatvaṃ vyāhanyeteti bhāvaḥ| kartukarmetarakārakānanvayitvamityuktau tu gauravameva, kecittu, anāyatyā gauravamaṅgīkṛtyapi uktameva kriyānādhārakārakānanvayitvamiti śabdāntareṇāhuḥ| taduktam "kriyā na yujyate liṅgakriyānādhārakārakaiḥ| asatvarūpatā tasyā iyamevāvadhāryatām||" (vā.pa. iti|) atra kārakaśabdaḥ śaktiparaḥ| kriyādhārakārake kartṛkarmaṇī eva| tadatiriktakaraṇādikārakairityartha iti| liṅgasaṅkhyānanvayitvameva asatvabhūtatvamityanye| vastutaḥ kriyāyāḥ anupamatvamevāsatvabhūtatvam| ata eva 'roditīva paṭhatī'tyādau nopamā kartrostu sā na| kriyāṃprati viśeṣaṇatvāt| api tūtprekṣāvyañjaka iva śabdāḥ| ata eva -0ka -0"san" (sū. 3-1-7) (san sūtram - dhātoḥ karmaṇaḥ samānakartṛkādicchāyāṃ vā (sū.3-1-7) sūtre "na vai tiṅantenopamānamastī"ti -0kha-0bhāṣyakāraḥ (ma.bhā.dvi.kha.pṛ.27|)| tatra saṃbhāvanārtha iva śabda iti kaiyaṭaścāha| upameyatvantu kriyāyā astyeva, 'brāhmaṇavadadhīte' ityādau tathā pratīteḥ| ata eva -0ga -0"cānadyatane luṅi"ti (anadyatane luḍ (sū 3-3-15.)) sūtrabhāṣye (ma.bhā.dvi.kha.pṛ.210|) 'iyaṃ tu kadā gantā yaivaṃ pādau nidadhātī'tyādāvadyatanabhaviṣyadviṣaye luṭ kathamityāśaṅkya 'ganteva gante'ti parihāraṃ 'na vai -0ṅa-0tiṅantenopamānamastī'ti dūṣayitvā''madyatana ivānadyatana' iti parihṛtam| nanu 'yatā vaisyononipatyādatte evamayaṃ dviṣantaṃ bhrātṛvyam (nipatyā) ādatte yamabhicarati śyenene'tyādau syenakartṛkādānakriyāyajamānakartṛkādānakriyayorastyevopamānopameyabhāva iti cenna - yathā śabdasya bhedakadharmaviśeṣarūpavadvācakatayā yat - prakāravat syenakartṛkaṃ pakṣyādānaṃ tatparkāravadyajamānakartṛkaṃ ripvādānamiti bodhottaraṃ, tameva prakārabhūtaṃ bhedakadharmamādāya tatprayuktāṃ vā''dānakriyāmādāyopamānaśyenabhinnayajamānaupameyamiti abhidhānamūlavyañjanayā bodhya ityubhayorapi śābdatvamevādāveva kriyayorupamābodhe tūktabhāṣyavirodha āpadyeta| kartrorapi sa na, viśeṣaṇatvāt| na ca tatvādeva tayordvitīyabodhe'pi na sambhavatīti vācyam| vaiyañjanikabodhe kasyāpi pratibandhakasyābhāvāditi gṛhāṇa| ye tu thālaḥ sādṛśyārthakatvaṃ vadanti teṣāṃ 'yat sadṛśo haristat sadṛśo hara' iti bodhe'pi 'harisadṛśo hara' iti, 'yathā haristathā hara' ityato bodhānāpatteḥ| anyathā sarvathetyādau sādṛśyānāpatteśca| mama tu "prakāravacane thāli" (sū. 5-3-23) tyatra vacanagrahaṇātthālaḥ prakāravadvācakatayā 'yatprakāravānharistatprakāravānhara' iti bodhe paścāduktarītyā sa bodhaḥ| ata evālaṅkārikā api -0ka-0'limpatī'vetyādāvutprekṣāmevodāharantīti dik|| (ka. limpatīva tamo'ṅgāni varṣatīvāñjanaṃ nabhaḥ| daṇḍinaḥ kāvyādarśe dvitīyaparicchede 226 kārikā|) -2etadeveti-2|| niruktāsatvabhūtatvamityarthaḥ|| -2tiṅpadairiti-2|| kriyāpradhānakaiḥ padairityarthaḥ| tena -01-0bhāṣyakṛtsammata (1. bhāṣyoktaṃ) "kriyāpradhānamākhyātami" (ni.a.1.pā.1) ti niruktabalādākhyātavyavahāryāṇāṃ bhāvakṛtyāntānāmedhitavyamityādīnāṃ nāsaṅgrahaḥ| yadvā tiṅpadairityasya tiṅantapadarityevārthaḥ| ākhyātapadavyavahāryāṇāmapyedhitavyamityādīnāmastibhavatītyādi-kriyāntarākāṅkṣādarśanānnasādhyatvā- satvabhūtatve| ata eva tadarthe na kārakāṇāmanvayaḥ| kriyā-pradhānatvavyavahārastu kriyāmātraviśeṣaṇatvāt| -01-0vastutastu (1.vastutaḥ) sādhyatvaṃ karmavyutpatyā niṣpādyatvameva| tadrūpeṇaiva dhātuto bodhāt| tadeva ca kārakānvayaprayojakam| hirugityāditau varjanārthasya sādhyatvenāpratyayānna kārakānvayaḥ| -02-0'edhitavyami'tyādau ca (L. 'edhitavyamityādau ca' - na dṛśyate|) tatvena bodhātkārakānvayaḥ| 'pacatikalpami'tyādāvapi sādhyatvenaivakriyāpratītiriti mūloktantu kārakānvayaprayojakavaijātyaṃ na yuktam| gurubhūtanirūktākāṅkṣāghaṭitavaijātyasvīkāre mānābhāvat| 'kṛṣṇaṃ namecce'dityādāvapi cetpadabalena tayā kārakānvayānāpatteśca| 'edhitavyaṃ','pacatikalpami'tyādau doṣācceti| 'pacatikalpaṃ devadatta' ityādau bodhāstu ākhyātārthe devadattasya viśeṣaṇatayā bodhyaḥ| abhedabodhastu | pratyayasya dyotakatvena kriyāpradhānatvena pratyayāntasya (bodhāt -) bādhāt| nāmārthayorityasya nāmajanyapratītiviśeṣyārthayorityarthāt| nanu dhātusāmānyasya -01-0vyāpārasāmānyavācakatve (V1vācakatvaṃ) nikhilavyāpārabodhasya dhātumātrādāpattirityata āha - ayañceti|| tattadrūpeṇeti|| atra 'buddhyā prakalpitā'bheda' (vā.pa.tṛ.kri.4) iti haryuktirapi pramāṇam| phūtkārādyavayavabhedasya samudāye tataḥ pratīteḥ| sa ca abhedasallāpo dhātutaḥ phūtkāratvādi - tattadrūpeṇa vyāpārasyā - pratītāvakiñcitkaraḥ syāditi| etena kriyātvaṃ śakyatāvacchedakamiti nirastam| -2tattaddhātaviti-2| ete pācitvādikameva śakyatāvacchedakamityuktaṃ bhavati| tena dhātutvaṃ śakyatāvacchedakam ityapi nirastam| aneka śakyatāvacchedakatve sati eka śakyatāvacchedakatvaṃ nānārthatvamityāśayenāśaṅkate - -2na ceti-2|| anugataśakyatāvacchedakatve sati ekaśakyatāvacchedakatvaṃ -02-0tadityāśayena (L. āśayena samādhatte - na dṛśyate) samādhatte || -2tadādīti-2|| buddhiviṣayatvopalakṣitaghaṭatvādidharmāvacchinnavācakaṃ tadādipadamiti tadādipade śaktigrahaḥ| ghaṭatvapaṭatvādīnāmanugamakabuddhiviṣayatvarūpadharmāvacchinnaśakyatāvacchedakatāsatvācchakteraikyam|-01-0nānāghaṭavyaktiviṣayaghaṭatvarūpānugatadharmāvacchinnaśakyatyaikatvavat| (L. ghaṭavyaktaviṣaya - na dṛśyate) iyāṃstu viśeṣaḥ - tatra ghaṭatvādiprakārakabodhānubhavātteṣāṃ ghaṭatvādīnāṃ dharmitāvacchedakatvarūpaviṣayatayā śaktigrahaviṣayatvaṃ, śaktiviṣaye bodhe viṣayatayā prakāratvañca| buddhisthatvasya tu -0 2-0śābdabodhe'bhānāddharmitāvacchedakatāvacchedakatvarūpaviṣayatayā (2. V1 tāvacchedaka - na dṛśyate) na śaktigrahaviṣayatvaṃ, nāpi tathā prakāratvamiti buddhiviṣayatvasya upalakṣaṇatvam| nanu tarhi, kathaṃ -03-0kvacit (3. V1 tarhi) buddhisthatvena bodhaḥ| tasyāpi buddhisthatvasya buddhisthatvenopalakṣaṇāt| ata eva -04-0tava (4. V1 tava - nāsti) tadādibhyaḥ kadācighghaṭa iti -05-0kadācijjātimāniti (5. V1 'kadācit ........ jītimānghaṭa' - nāvalokyate|) kadācit jātimānghaṭa iti kadācit buddhistho ghaṭa iti bodhaḥ| na ca nānārthatvenābhimataharipadārthatāvacchedakānāmindratvādīnāmapi buddhisthatvenānugamānnānārthocchedaprasaṅga iti śaṅkyam| tadādi sarvanāmabhya uktarītyā nānārūpeṇaikasya bodho'nubhūyate, na haryādipadebhyaḥ śabdaśaktisvābhāvyāditi viśeṣāt| ata eva tebhyo na kadācidapi 'jātimān hari'rityādi krameṇa bodha iti spaṣṭaṃ -0ka-0bhaṭṭācāryanirmita'śaktivāde'| (ka. śaktivādaḥ - viśeṣakāṇḍam - pṛ.91) vastutasteṣāṃ ghaṭatvādidharmāṇāṃ viśiṣyajñānābhāvena tattadrūpeṇa śaktigrahāsambhavāt tathā bodhasyāsambhavānna buddhi - viṣayatvopalakṣitaghaṭatvādyavacchinne tadādipadaśaktiḥ, api tu buddhiviṣayatvena buddhiviṣaye tadādeḥ śaktiḥ| sarvasyāpi buddhi-viṣayatvenaiva bodhaśca| ata eva "tasyāpatyami" (sū. 4-1-91) ti sūtre -0kha-0bhāṣye (ma.bhā.dvi.kha.pṛ.370) 'sarvanāmanirdeśe viśeṣā'sampratyayaḥ sāmānyanirdeśāt tataśca tacchabdādevapratyayaḥ syādi'tyāśaṅkya apatya śabdasya sambandhiviśeṣākāṅkṣatayā "tasyāpatyami" (sū 4-1-92) tyuktāvapi ākāṅkṣāyā anivṛttestena tadādinā'patyasya viśeṣaṇāyogāttatra tadviśeṣavācina utpattiriti siddhāntitam| ata eva ca "tasminniti" (sū 1-1-66) sūtre -0ga-0bhāṣye (ma.bhā.dvi.kha.pṛ. 508) "sarvanāmnā'yaṃ nirdeśaḥ kriyate sarvanāma ca sāmānyavāci" ityuktam| dvividhādapi bhāṣyāt sakalasādhāraṇabuddhiviṣayatvarūpasāmānyameva pravṛttinimittamiti labhyate, tvaduktau tu etadbhāṣyavirodhaḥ spaṣṭa eva| kiñca nānārthatāyāḥ tadādīnāṃ vāraṇāyaitāvānprayāsastava| tacca laghunā maduktaprakāreṇāpi vāritamevetyalam| nanu phūtkāratvādīnāmanugamakaṃ buddhisthatvamityatra kiṃ vinigamakamityata āha - liṅgakriyānādhārakārakaiḥ| asatvabhūtatā tasyā iyamevāvadhāryatām||" (vā.pa ) iti| 'pacati bhūyate' iti tu satyabhidhāne iṣṭameveti saṃkṣepaḥ| yadapi yadvā ekena tiṅantena vākyārthaṃ janayitvā yatra dvitīyena tiṅantena saṃbhūyavākyārtho janyate, tatra dvitīyāntatvādina tantram| ata eva 'nīlo ghaṭaḥ paśye'ti na prayogaḥ| tatra prathamaṃ tiṅantena vākyārthabodhajananābhāvena dvitīyāntatvāpekṣaṇāt| 'pasya mṛgo dhāvatī'tyādau tu ekatiṅantena prathamaṃ bodhaṃ janayitvā tiṅantāntareṇa anvayabodhajananena dvitīyāntatvānapekṣaṇānna doṣa iti| tadapi na| 'pasya lakṣmaṇa pampāyāṃ bakaḥ paramadhārmika' ityāderviśiṣṭagatakarmatvavivakṣāyāṃ sādhutvena tavābhimatasyāsādhutvāpatteḥ| na ca tatrāpyastītyadhyāhāreṇaikakriyānvayabodha pūrvakakriyāntarānvayabodhasatvāduktaniyamāvyāghāta iti vācyam| tathā sati 'nīlo ghaṭaḥ paśye'tyāderapi tadadhyāhāreṇa sādhutvāpatteḥ| ekasyaiva prayogasya pakṣabhedena sādhutvāsādhutvayoḥ durvacatvācca| yadapi 'aśvo gacchatyānaye'tyādau āgamanakriyāyāmānayanakarmatvaṃ bādhitamiti dūṣaṇaṃ, tadapi aśvagata- karmatvasya gamanādāvupacāreṇa kriyāvatorabhedena vā pariharaṇīyam| iyameva 'māra paśya mṛgo dhāvatī'tyādāvapi gatiḥ| kecittu uktalakṣyadvaye tamityadyāhāreṇa vākyabhedamudājahruḥ| anye tu 'vidhipratibedhau viśeṣaṇamupasaṅkrāmataḥ sati viśeṣye bādhe' iti nyāyena 'śikhīdhvasta' itivat viśeṣyabūtagamanadhāvanayoḥ kriyayoḥ ānayanamāraṇarūpakriyākarmatvāsambhave'pi tadviśeṣaṇībhūtakartreraśvamgayostadanvayaḥ| na caivaṃ dvitīyāpattiriti vācyam| śābdakarmatvānvayinyeva dvitīyāpravṛtteḥ| ata eva "aruṇekahāyanī" (jai.sū.3-1-6) nyāyena pratyekaṃ kriyābiprāyeṇa 'kaṭo'pi karma bhīṣmādayopi karme'ti bhāṣyakṛduktiḥ saṅgacchate| anyathā viśiṣṭasya karmatve'pi ārthikapratyekakarmatvamādāya pratyekaṃ dvitīyotpattau siddhāyāṃ taduktāsaṅgatiḥ| 'māraya mṛgo dhāvatī'tyatra avarodhanānukūlavyāpārārthakatvena mṛddhātostasya ca dhāvane'bādhādupapattiḥ| mṛge prāṇaviyogarūpaṃ māraṇantu ārthikaṃ pratīyata ityapyāhuḥ| tasmāt (ka. anabhihite (sū.2-3-1) ma.bhā.dvi.kha.pṛ.479.) jñānārthakadhātusamabivyāhāre ekakriyāprakārakakarmatāsaṃsargakāparakriyāviśeṣyakabodhaḥ svārasiko'bādhāt| tadbhinnārthaka dhātusamabhivyāhāre tu bādhāt| āropābhedābhyāṃ nirvāhyā yadi prayogāḥ santi| pasya lakṣmaṇetyādi prayogāṇāntvanabhidhānameva| yadi tatsattāyāmāgrahastaharyuktarītyā prathamotpattaye'stītyadhyāhṛtya nirvāhyā iti vivekatavyam|
